component.name: Tetia
component.summary: Library for manga, images and video

description.p: Tetia keeps your manga, pictures and videos in one place: browse collections, tag and rate what is in them, and find anything with a single search box.

ul.li: Collections of folders for photos, videos, manga and books, with covers and nested subfolders
Tags in five categories, ratings and favorites, with bulk tagging by click or drag selection
One search box for tags and file names, across the whole library or inside a folder
Moved and renamed files keep their tags and favorites
Private profiles with their own library, optionally encrypted in a KDE Plasma Vault

screenshot.caption: Search tags and file names across every collection
Tag your files by category and set a content rating
Browse a folder of images as a thumbnail grid
Read manga and PDF volumes with cover thumbnails
Keep your favorite collections and books in one place
View images full screen with arrow-key navigation

description.p: Folders open at once and are checked for changes in the background, so big folders on slow drives no longer freeze the window. Switching out of a vault profile waits for Tetia's own work to let go of the vault before locking it. Thumbnails and reader pages are drawn at the size the screen needs. Player and purge mode fixes.

Fixes switching to a private profile in installs that start Tetia through a wrapper (such as the Nix package): the window closed and Tetia never reopened in the profile. It now restarts the same way it was started.
Tetia now plays video and reads manga, and understands TV shows:

ul.li: A video player built on libmpv: hardware decoding, subtitle and audio track pickers (embedded or separate files), your own click zones, and a gallery mode that steps through a folder of clips
Shows: a folder of videos can be a series with a page of its own, with poster, description, tags and episodes by season; season and episode numbers are read from the file names
Tetia remembers where you stopped, marks what you have watched, and shows progress bars and episode lengths
A page reader for comics, PDFs and picture EPUBs, with paged and long-strip layouts, right-to-left reading, zoom, auto-scroll and your place kept per book
Virtual folders to sort a library without moving any files
A tag browser, tags shown in the picture viewer, and series that are tagged, rated and favorited as one item and found as one tile in a search
One tile layout for every grid, with badges that never cover a picture
Purge mode: swipe through a folder of pictures to keep them or send them to the Trash, with a review first
Folders of chapter files can be shown as one series that opens where you left off, and a folder holding one file shows as that file
Covers for comics, EPUBs and PDFs, and a picker to choose the cover page by hand
RAR, 7z and tar comics are read whatever their file extension says
A metadata panel, sort options, and five tile sizes remembered per category
Moving files to the Trash now works correctly in the Flatpak
